user.title: Wanjiale Account
user.description: Enter your Wanjiale app credentials (used to login to the machtalk cloud).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please check network and credentials

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured in Home Assistant

init.title: Wanjiale Advanced Options
init.description: A model template describes the template capability, which may differ from the real device (e.g. the template exposes zero-cold-water points while the device never raises the feature bit). Force-enable a feature that was not detected, or force-disable a mis-detected one. Feature overrides are stored per device, so multiple devices on the same account do not affect each other; pick a device first. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

account.title: Account settings
account.description: These settings apply to the whole account, not to a single device.

data.enable_control_rights: Enable multi-client control-rights preemption (off by default)

data_description.enable_control_rights: When enabled, the login phone number is used to claim the device control right before each command (mirrors the official app's multi-client exclusion). Keep it off if your model does not check control rights.
data_description.rescan_devices: When checked and saved, this reload re-fetches devices from the cloud so newly added devices are admitted. The option is not persisted and applies to this reload only.

device.title: Select a device
device.description: Choose the device whose feature overrides you want to edit. Each device is stored separately.

data_description.device_did: Only devices already admitted to Home Assistant are listed.

device_detail.title: Feature overrides
device_detail.description: Checked features create entities on "{device}"; unchecked ones do not. This only affects that device. The integration reloads after saving.

data_description.device_features: Pre-checked to match what is currently active: check to enable, uncheck to disable. Features you do not touch keep following the capability table automatically.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not initialized yet, so the device list is unavailable. Please try again once it has loaded.
abort.device_gone: The selected device is no longer available. Please go back and choose again.
abort.no_features: Feature overrides are not supported for this device's category.
